query: find frames where the left arm is most certain with respect to the rest of the body

definitions.gap_to_rest_of_body: level of the most certain other body group minus the level of the part (percentile points, highest first)
definitions.part_certainty: level of the part (percentile points, lowest first)
definitions.level: mean over the part's body groups of each group's mean per-vertex percentile (0-100)
definitions.percentiles: CLUE's per-vertex sigma ranked among that vertex's values over 6,118 person-frames of in-the-wild video
